title: Affine preparation with one geometrically reduced generic point
statement: Let f:X→S be locally of finite type and quasi-compact with S irreducible. There exist a nonempty affine open U⊆S, an integral affine scheme T, and a finite universal homeomorphism q:T→U such that the reduced pullback is flat, locally of finite presentation, quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and its fibre over a generic point η of T is geometrically reduced.

proof.text: Construct the finite purely inseparable affine model over a reduced affine open, identify the reduced generic fibre, and shrink to the intersection of the generic flatness and quasi-separatedness opens.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_generic_geometricallyReduced_affine_model {X S : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] [IrreducibleSpace S] :
    ∃ U : S.Opens, (U : Set S).Nonempty ∧ IsAffineOpen U ∧
      ∃ T : Scheme.{u}, IsIntegral T ∧ IsAffine T ∧
        ∃ q : T ⟶ U.toScheme, IsFinite q ∧
          (topologically IsHomeomorph).universally q ∧
          Flat ((pullback f (q ≫ U.ι)).nilradical.subschemeι ≫
            pullback.snd f (q ≫ U.ι)) ∧
          LocallyOfFinitePresentation ((pullback f (q ≫ U.ι)).nilradical.subschemeι ≫
            pullback.snd f (q ≫ U.ι)) ∧
          QuasiCompact ((pullback f (q ≫ U.ι)).nilradical.subschemeι ≫
            pullback.snd f (q ≫ U.ι)) ∧
          QuasiSeparated ((pullback f (q ≫ U.ι)).nilradical.subschemeι ≫
            pullback.snd f (q ≫ U.ι)) ∧
          ∃ η : T, IsGenericPoint η Set.univ ∧ GeometricallyReduced
            (((pullback f (q ≫ U.ι)).nilradical.subschemeι ≫
              pullback.snd f (q ≫ U.ι)).fiberToSpecResidueField η)
